messages:
Ana L: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands security segment — threading answers here for KMS/BYOQ, VPC audit logs, and SOC2 evidence.

Maria P: Any ETA on BYOQ/HSM for Private? customers keep pressing.

Cory S: Roadmap item: HSM-backed BYOQ for Private targeted H2 next quarter. Pilot with 2 customers, then broader release. We'll publish pilot criteria and required infra configs.

Devin G: Will the pilot include ops runbook for CloudTrail/VPC Flow Logs? we need exact commands to hand customers.

Cory S: Yes. Ops playbook will include provider-specific config snippets and recommended retention (default 365d). Example AWS Flow Log snippet we plan to recommend: 
```
aws ec2 create-flow-logs --resource-type VPC --resource-id vpc-xxxx --traffic-type ALL --log-destination-type cloud-watch-logs --log-destination arn:aws:logs:...
```
And CloudTrail enablement: 
```
aws cloudtrail create-trail --name redwood-audit --s3-bucket-name redwood-audit-bucket --is-multi-region-trail
aws cloudtrail start-logging --name redwood-audit
```

Jesse T: For Private, logs go to customer buckets by default, right? or do we pull copies for Console?

Cory S: Default is customer-controlled buckets (S3/GCS) with CMK encryption. We offer an optional ingestion connector to index/hydrate readonly telemetry into Console features; connector supports customer CMKs or our managed keys. Connector is opt-in and audited.

Maria P: SOC2/ISO evidence — what will we provide to customers? they ask for key rotation proof, access logs, and policy docs.

Cory S: We'll publish an evidence pack: policy templates, how-to export rotation logs, sample CloudTrail filters for KMS events, role mapping docs, and a SOC2 evidence checklist. Example CloudTrail lookup for KMS rotation events: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=EnableKeyRotation --start-time 2023-01-01 --end-time 2023-12-31
```

Devin G: Hosted API — is key management in SOC2 scope?

Cory S: Yes, hosted API is in SOC2 Type II scope. We use provider HSMs for key protection today. BYOQ for hosted customers planned but requires contractual addenda. We'll document exact scope in the compliance matrix.

SecurityBot: Evidence template uploaded: /ops/security/evidence-requests.xlsx :white_check_mark:

Ana L: Action items: Cory to share BYOQ timeline + pilot criteria by EOD Friday; Security to publish playbook draft & evidence checklist next week; Devin/Jesse to review cloud snippet accuracy. I'll compile FAQ and one-pager after drafts land.

Jesse T: Ack. Can test ingestion connector with staged S3.

Maria P: Please tag customer-success on publish. customers will appreciate concrete steps. :pray:

Cory S: Will do. Tagging follow-ups: @Devin G @Jesse T @Ana L @Maria P. I'll drop draft links here when ready.

Ana L: Thanks all, closing this thread unless new questions come up. :v:
